title: Phase 3 local DiffuEraser stopped under RAM pressure
body: CONFIRMED: one 43-frame original cloth scene prepared and model initialization attempted on RTX 2060 6 GiB / about 16 GiB system RAM. Operator cancelled at 964600 KiB free system RAM. Child process exited; temporary PCM copy and ROI removed. No candidate output, no visual verdict, no observed CUDA OOM. No RunPod calls. Runtime and failure log retained. More-memory execution remains pending.
